name: parkktech/fastmagento-checkout
description: FastMagento Checkout — makes the Magento 2 onepage checkout paint instantly. Renders a cacheable form shell with a skeleton, then hydrates window.checkoutConfig over an async request so the heavy per-quote config no longer blocks first paint. Optional add-on to FastMagento; works standalone on base Magento (no Hyvä/Breeze required). Fails safe to stock checkout via an admin toggle or ?fastcheckout=0.

suggest.parkktech/fastmagento: Serve catalog, category, search and layered navigation from OpenSearch. FastMagento Checkout works with or without it.
